<thought>We need to find a retrosynthetic template for a nucleophilic aromatic substitution (S_NAr) where a halide is replaced by an amine. Using the search tool with criteria that the forward reaction breaks a halide and forms an amine should return suitable templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
